pro_course_detail.title: Speak on the Spot! Conversation Practice -  The Learn by Doing Method
pro_course_detail.description:
These sessions are for students who want a diligent one-on-one coach to help them increase their overall English fluency through casual conversation practice.

Learning a second language takes exercise - like learning a dance. In order to really get good at speaking English and not lose that ability (not forget "the moves"), it's important that you build muscle memory in your mouth by using the language frequently and consistently. Unfortunately, there are still many people around the globe who currently don't encounter enough opportunities in their day-to-day lives to practice English. 

Many non-native English speakers after reaching a certain level, never improve their communication skills, and in unfortunate cases, some even start to lose skills they had previously worked hard to gain. 

I enjoy helping students improve their own sentences by identifying and/or recalling sophisticated words and then getting them in the habit of incorporating those words into their speech.

Let's chat about topics of your choice unless you prefer Teacher Amelia to suggest some. During these conversations, Amelia will ask lots of questions so you will learn to use the English language spontaneously and practically rather than from a boring irrelevant textbook. We can discuss unfamiliar vocabulary words, and grammatical rules pertinent to your sentences.

If there's a specific topic you'd like to study, please let me know! I enjoy creating customized materials for my students, tailored to help them achieve their individual goals. Additionally, I've invested in an excellent online resource featuring hundreds of well-organized worksheets, including articles, videos, audio files, vocabulary exercises, and discussion questions. These resources can be utilized to keep our "free conversation" lessons centered around specific topics that interest and motivate you. I'm also eager to hear about your career and any personal life updates you'd like to share during our conversations.

course_info.trial_description:
Fun Grammar Lessons for young learners and Grammar Practice for adults

My Grammar Practice for adults worksheets are filled with useful, everyday language that will boost your grammar skills and help you develop your fluency. Each lesson includes a variety of reading, writing and speaking tasks activities on a particular grammar target. These lessons are a lifeline for any student looking for extra ways to reinforce a specific grammar point.

Fun Grammar Lessons teach young learners the building blocks of English with kid-friendly lessons that are full of pictures and fun activities. Each lesson includes simple grammar notes and exercises that will help introduce and develop core grammar skills required for fluency. 

I also have Grammar Assessment Tests to determine your current English level. 

Grammar Test 1-Beg: a low or mid-range score indicates that students should use our beginner-level materials. A high score indicates that they can use low-intermediate or intermediate materials. 

Grammar Test 2-Low Int: a low or mid-range score indicates that students should use our beginner or low-intermediate materials. A high score indicates that they can use intermediate materials. 

Grammar Test 3 – Int: it is recommended that students get a high grade on Grammar Tests 1 and 2 before trying Test 3. For placement, a low or mid-range score on Grammar Test 3 indicates that students should use our intermediate-level materials. A high score indicates that they may be ready for high-intermediate or advanced materials. 

Grammar Test 4 - High Int – Adv: it is also recommended that students get a high grade on Grammar Tests 1, 2, and 3 before trying Test 4. For placement, a low or mid-range score on Grammar Test 4 indicates that students should use our intermediate – high-intermediate materials. A high score indicates that they can use advanced materials as well as authentic reading and listening materials.
